feature_title: Add user authentication with JWT tokens
problem_statement: The application has no authentication. Any user can access any endpoint without credentials, which is a security risk for production deployment.
root_cause: Authentication was deferred during initial prototype phase and never implemented.
solution_overview: Implement JWT-based authentication with bcrypt password hashing, middleware-based route protection, and refresh token rotation.

architectural_decisions.title: JWT over session-based auth
architectural_decisions.context: Need stateless auth for horizontal scaling
architectural_decisions.decision: Use JWT with short-lived access tokens (15min) and longer refresh tokens (7d)

alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Adds infrastructure dependency and prevents stateless scaling

architectural_decisions.rationale: JWT enables stateless auth which aligns with the planned Kubernetes deployment. Short-lived tokens mitigate the revocation limitation.
architectural_decisions.consequences: Must implement refresh token rotation and maintain a token blacklist for forced logout.

tasks.title: Implement user model and password hashing
tasks.description: Create User model with email/password fields, bcrypt hashing on save, and password comparison method.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a user is created with a password THEN the password is stored as bcrypt hash with cost >= 10
WHEN comparePassword is called with correct password THEN it returns true
WHEN comparePassword is called with wrong password THEN it returns false
tasks.security_notes: Handles credentials — bcrypt with cost 12, constant-time comparison, no plaintext storage

tasks.title: Implement JWT token service
tasks.description: Create token service for generating and verifying access/refresh JWT tokens with proper claims.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN generateAccessToken is called THEN it returns a JWT with 15min expiry and user_id claim
WHEN generateRefreshToken is called THEN it returns a JWT with 7d expiry
WHEN verifyToken is called with expired token THEN it throws TokenExpiredError
tasks.security_notes: Uses RS256 algorithm, keys from environment variables, never hardcoded

tasks.title: Implement auth middleware and login/register routes
tasks.description: Create auth middleware that validates JWT on protected routes, and login/register endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN request has valid JWT in Authorization header THEN middleware passes and sets req.user
WHEN request has expired JWT THEN middleware returns 401 with safe message
WHEN POST /auth/register with valid data THEN user is created and tokens returned
WHEN POST /auth/login with valid credentials THEN tokens returned
WHEN POST /auth/login with invalid credentials THEN 401 returned with safe message
tasks.security_notes: Rate limit login to 5 req/min/IP, no user enumeration in error messages

rollback: git revert HEAD~3 (one commit per task)
